user.title: Connect to ElOverblik
user.description: Paste a refresh token from [eloverblik.dk](https://eloverblik.dk/welcome). Open Datadeling, create a token for the metering points you want to share, and paste it here. The token stays valid for up to a year.

data_description.refresh_token: Created under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk. It is stored in Home Assistant and used only to read your own DataHub metering data.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the refresh token
reauth_confirm.description: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token for {name}. It has expired or been revoked. Create a new one under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk and paste it here.

data_description.refresh_token: The new token replaces the one that stopped working. Your selected metering points are kept.

metering_points.title: Choose metering points
metering_points.description: Consumption is electricity bought from the grid. Export/sale is electricity delivered to the grid, for example from solar panels. If a parent point and its children are both listed, prefer the children (D07 for grid consumption and D06 for export) so the Energy dashboard does not count the same electricity twice.

error.invalid_auth: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token. Create a new one under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach ElOverblik, or ElOverblik returned an error. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rate_limited: ElOverblik is limiting requests right now. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong while contacting ElOverblik.
error.no_selection: Select at least one metering point.
error.invalid_option: The polling interval must be between 1 and 24 hours, and the history must be between 1 and 365 days.

abort.already_configured: This ElOverblik account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This ElOverblik account is already being configured.
abort.no_metering_points: This account has no linked metering points. Link a metering point on eloverblik.dk and try again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new token belongs to a different ElOverblik account.

init.title: ElOverblik options
init.description: ElOverblik publishes metering data with a delay of about one to three days. Polling every few hours is enough and stays inside Energinet's rate limits.

data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often metering data is fetched. Minimum 1 hour. The default is 6 hours.
data_description.history_days: How many days are written to the Energy dashboard the first time statistics are imported. Maximum 365 days. Later increases do not rewrite hours that are already stored.
data_description.import_statistics: Writes hourly consumption and export as long-term statistics, so you can pick them under grid consumption and return to grid.

error.invalid_option: The polling interval must be between 1 and 24 hours, and the history must be between 1 and 365 days.
